name: crag-bench-rag-strategies
description: Benchmarking six advanced RAG strategies (RAG Fusion, HyDE, CRAG, Graph RAG, Multi-Query, and RRR) against the CRAG dataset, a noisy pre-crawled web corpus spanning finance, music, movies, sports, and general knowledge. Includes a shared embedding index, per-pipeline evaluation, and a minimal brutalist frontend for interactive comparison.
